senses.gloss: f. (part. Ithpe. of גְּנֵי) = h. מְגוּנֶּה (v. גָּנָה), blame-worthy; מילתא מ׳ blemish, defect.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:9">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (prov.) <he>מילתא דאית בך מ׳ וכ׳</he> what blemish there be in thee, be the first to tell it; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>מילתא דמִיגַּ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="C01075"><he>גנאה</he></cite>).
